title: Yellow Spicy Croatian Fiordilatte Skewers
description: A spicy and juicy Croatian dish featuring fiordilatte, perfect for a crowd, and Whole30 friendly. This recipe combines the flavors of Croatia with a spicy kick.
instructions: Preheat grill to medium high heat.
In a large bowl, whisk together smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add the pork sausage to the bowl and mix until just combined.
Thread the fiordilatte cheese, pork sausage mixture, yellow bell pepper, and red onion onto skewers.
Brush the skewers with olive oil.
Grill the skewers for 10 minutes, turning occasionally.
While the skewers are grilling, mix the minced garlic with a pinch of salt.
After 10 minutes, brush the skewers with the garlic mixture.
Continue grilling for an additional 2 minutes.
Remove the skewers from the grill and let rest for 2 minutes.
